name: Vapin Ape Full Spectrum Disposable | Animal Mints
description: This indica hybrid strain is cultivated by crossing Animal Cookies with Sinmint Cookies. This strain is high in calming terpenes like Myrcene, Terpinolene, and Caryophyllene that together create a strong body and head high, making it ideal for after work and evening use. This strain features a sweet, pungent aroma that is minty on the exhale.
